verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a GitLab API, let alone one that matches what the UI can do. Related items don't establish API–UI parity: an MCP connection claim (gitlab-docs-23), an official CLI (gitlab-probe-4), and a failed OpenAPI spec probe (gitlab-probe-3). Several security features are described as UI or CI-config actions with no API equivalent mentioned.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
